item.title: Naritasan Setsubun Guide: Bean-Throwing Festival & Access
item.description: Each February 3rd, Narita-san Shinshoji Temple hosts one of Japan’s most famous Setsubun celebrations — the bean-throwing ritual that drives out bad luck and welcomes spring. From a special stage, costumed participants hurl roasted soybeans (and lucky packets) to huge crowds shouting the traditional cry, and Narita-san is renowned for its celebrity guests: famous sumo grand champions, NHK taiga drama actors and other stars take part, drawing big crowds and national TV coverage.
